name: bounded-force-concentration-potential-v1
status: isolated unwired prototype; requires current-contract integration and GPU qualification
required_guards: fresh optimizer matched control/candidate with identical initialization, geometry, seeds, pool, resets and RL budgets
same gamma for environment potential and learner; terminal and truncated potentials zero
at least 30000 steady end-to-end SPS including added reductions
paired wins, merges of both stacks>=10, largest-stack share, land/army at turn100 and200, attack frequency and capital survival
reject reduced expansion or passive concentration without broad strength improvement
causal_limits: Replay concentration correlates with wins; this does not establish reward causality.
Turn100 activation introduces boundary reward and can change earlier actions through credit assignment.
Concentration can penalize later expansion or encourage camping under approximate PPO.
Exact discounted shaping telescopes; approximate PPO, clipping and finite budgets do not guarantee the same learned policy.
